value.title: Drawn in to the Land of Adventure
value.synopsis: Makoto is preparing a science experiment for the school festival; when jealous rival Jinnai sabotages it, he inadvertently opens a portal to a strange and magnificent world.

value.title: Exploring the Kingdom of Mystery
value.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa rescue a beautiful young woman from giant humanoid bugs; she introduces herself as Princess Rune Venus of Roshtaria.

value.title: The Enchanting Princess
value.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa look for a way home; meanwhile, Jinnai enchants the Bugrom's Queen with his idea to attack a village's water supply.

value.title: The Lonely Priestess
value.synopsis: Rune Venus tells Makoto about Great Priestesses whose ancient magic might be able to take him home.

value.title: The Shrine of Wind
value.synopsis: Afura Mann, the Priestess of Wind, has a massive library that may have answers for Makoto.

value.title: A Game of Chance and Fire
value.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa journey to meet the Priestess of Fire, Shayla.

value.title: A Golden Opportunity
value.synopsis: While others are seeking a way home, Nanami is working.

value.title: Reunion
value.synopsis: Miz Mistal wishes for Mr. Fujisawa's love at a legendary fountain; when it malfunctions, she fears a catastrophe has occurred.

value.title: House of Thieves
value.synopsis: Nanami decides to open her own restaurant; when the kingdom's vegetables suddenly go missing, Makoto attempts to solve the mystery.

value.title: The Jungle Beast
value.synopsis: A village is being threatened by a monster who's is attacking its crops and livestock; seeking adventure, Mr. Fujisawa volunteers to go on a monster hunt.

value.title: A Child's Heart
value.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa decide to help Rune Venus take care of some orphaned children.

value.title: Tomb of the Demon God
value.synopsis: An oppressive heat wave covers the land.

value.title: Pure Evil Genius
value.synopsis: The ultimate weapon has awoken, and she's under the control of Jinnai.

value.title: The Legendary Snowfields
value.synopsis: One of the seven wonders of El-Hazard, the Legendary Snow falls only once every 100 years.

value.title: Tale of the Priestess
value.synopsis: A flashback to Shayla's encounter with an apprentice priestess that changed her destiny.

value.title: Whirlwind
value.synopsis: A gigantic whirlwind appears in the deserts of Roshtaria.

value.title: The Eye of God
value.synopsis: Rune Venus dreams of a golden room from her childhood, and wonders if it's the Chamber of Promises; Makoto goes with her to investigate.

value.title: Operation: Abduction
value.synopsis: Jinnai attempts to reverse his fortunes with a daring plan.

value.title: Hive of Darkness
value.synopsis: Makoto and Mr. Fujisawa are in hot pursuit of Jinnai in an attempt to rescue Rune Venus.

value.title: Jinnai: Sister vs. Brother
value.synopsis: Jinnai's decision to kidnap Nanami along with Rune Venus backfires when she discovers she can speak to the Bugrom.

value.title: A Love in Peril
value.synopsis: The Great Saint River is a dangerous, forbidden sanctuary.

value.title: A Death-Defying Rescue
value.synopsis: Makoto will have to face the Bugrom, Ifurita, and Jinnai's greatest trump card: Rune Venus.

value.title: Escape
value.synopsis: While Afura Mann and the Bugrom are searching for the Princess, Nanami has already found her.

value.title: Destiny
value.synopsis: Cataclysms rock the world and the Bugrom launch an all-out invasion; worst of all, the Eye of God is falling out of its orbit.

value.title: The End of the World
value.synopsis: Jinnai's dreams of conquest are about to come to fruition, but when Ifurita's personality abruptly changes, he looses control of her.

value.title: The Eternal Dream
value.synopsis: Makoto releases the reactor energy from the Eye of God.
